name: Ezsha – Simple Liquid Glass Share Button
author: M. Nasikin

sections.description:
Ezsha is a lightweight and no-config plugin that adds elegant Font Awesome-powered share buttons to your WordPress single posts, pages, products, and custom post types.

Key Features:
* No configuration needed – plug and play
* Localized Fontawesome icons (loads only the necessary fonts)
* Compatible with WooCommerce and custom post types
* Optimized performance and minimal footprint
* Fontawesome v6.x integration

License

MIT License – https://github.com/mnasikin/Ezsha/blob/main/LICENSE
sections.installation:
1. Download this repository as a ZIP file.
  2. Login to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Upload the downloaded ZIP file and click Install.
  5. Activate the plugin.
  6. Share buttons will now appear on your single posts and pages.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require any setup?

Nope! It works out of the box—no settings or configuration required.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes, it displays share buttons on WooCommerce single product pages.
sections.changelog:
2.1.0

  • New: Apple-style “Liquid Glass” (glassmorphism) redesign for the share button and panel
  • New: Settings page (Settings > Ezsha) to choose the share button position
  • New: Separate position options for desktop and mobile (left, right, or bottom center)
  • New: Enable/disable the Liquid Glass effect (falls back to a flat design when disabled; enabled by default)

2.0.1

  • Compability check with wordpress 6.9
  • Remove console debug on fail

2.0.0

  • Remove fontawesome library. using direct SVG
  • Add animation on share button
  • Layout change

1.0.1

  • Initial public release
